title: ML-video-game-analysis-synthetic
summary: A small analysis project that applies k-nearest neighbors and regression/classification models to a simplified video game dataset, using it to predict gaming preference and gender from age, height, weight, and gender. It uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata with GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer to generate a 5x-extended synthetic dataset, run to test synthetic data accuracy against the trained ML models.
evidence: sdv_generate_videog_data.py:25-40 - GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer both fit and sampled via sdv.single_table
